output_text: Precision is how many of your "positive" tickets (like complaints about missing receipts) are actually correct—meaning the AI didn't flag something that isn't an issue. High precision means you're not being too aggressive with warnings, but low precision suggests you might be sending false alarms to customers who aren't having problems at all. Recall is how many actual issues in your system get caught by the classifier so they can be fixed. A high recall score (like 95%) tells us that for every single complaint a customer actually has about missing receipts, our AI will correctly identify it and flag it as needing attention before the customer gets frustrated or loses their ticket to another support agent. Low recall means you're letting some real problems slip through undetected because your model is too lenient on what counts as an issue.
